subject: High School Culture and Disciplinary Policy Review
overview: The committee addressed recent incidents of violence at Medford High School, hearing extensive testimony from students regarding safety and school climate. Major actions included authorizing an independent culture and climate assessment and discussing the implementation of restorative justice practices.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: Approved routine bills, payrolls, and meeting minutes from November 15, 2021.

items.title: Special Education Subcommittee Report
items.summary: Approved subcommittee minutes and recommended establishing Best Buddies programming and disability awareness projects.

items.title: Superintendent's Updates
items.summary: Dr. Edouard-Vincent addressed recent violence at the high school, reported a rise in COVID-19 positivity to nearly 4%, and recognized student achievements in music and athletics.

items.title: Briefing on Student Disciplinary Policies and School Climate
items.summary: Administrators presented a plan to narrowly tailor exclusionary discipline and expand restorative justice practices to address behavioral concerns and social-emotional needs.

items.title: Public Comment on School Culture
items.summary: Students and residents described a culture of insecurity at the high school and criticized the administration's response to violence, bullying, and student protests.

items.title: Early Literacy Report
items.summary: Staff presented on the alignment of district instruction with the 'science of reading' and the use of new NWEA MAP growth assessments and tiered interventions.

items.title: Superintendent's Goals
items.summary: Approved revised performance goals for the 2021-2022 school year.

items.title: Resolution on Pesticide Protections
items.summary: Approved a resolution supporting state legislation to restrict the use of toxic pesticides on outdoor school grounds.

items.title: Out-of-School Suspension Policy Amendments
items.summary: Tabled a motion regarding out-of-school suspension guidelines until the January 3 meeting.

items.title: Referral of Suspension Policy to Subcommittee
items.summary: Referred a review of the 2020 out-of-school suspension policy and its implementation to the Rules, Policy, and Equity Subcommittee.

items.title: Locker Room Tour and Athletics Spending Report
items.summary: Approved a motion to schedule a committee tour of high school locker rooms and produce a comprehensive report on sports spending by February.

items.title: School Climate and Culture Assessment RFP
items.summary: Approved the expenditure of up to $50,000 to hire an independent vendor for a comprehensive culture and climate assessment of the high school and middle schools.
